checkpoint_review: The Router correctly identified the presence of the loupe components and materials. However, it was too lenient on the 'text_gibberish' artifact, which directly impacts the realism of the 'black metal frame' context. More importantly, the Router marked 'Overall length when folded is pocket-sized' as untestable. While there is no hand for scale, the object's proportions relative to its own features (lens diameter vs case size) and standard product photography conventions make this testable and present; marking it N/A unnecessarily penalizes the alignment score. The Router also missed that the background object's hinge mechanism is visually ambiguous/melted, which relates to the 'fold into protective casing' checkpoint.
artifact_review: The Router identified text gibberish (severity 1) and texture anomaly (severity 1). I agree with the text gibberish finding but believe the severity is underestimated (should be 2-3) because the text is not just 'slightly distorted' but clearly nonsensical/garbled, which is a strong AI indicator. The texture anomaly is valid but minor. A new significant artifact is the structural ambiguity of the background case's hinge: the transition between the lid and base lacks clear mechanical definition, appearing slightly fused or melted, which contradicts the 'hinged cover' functional requirement. This structural defect outweighs the minor texture issues.
